greeting: Welcome to PawCare Veterinary Clinic. I can help you with appointment bookings, pet care services, clinic hours, and common questions. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you book a veterinary appointment. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We offer routine check-ups, vaccinations, wellness reviews, dental consultation, and urgent assessment support.
We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Please let us know at least 2 hours before your visit if you need to cancel or reschedule.

cancellation_policy: Please inform us at least 2 hours before your appointment if you need to cancel or reschedule.
pricing: Pet care service pricing depends on the selected treatment and visit type. The team can confirm the best option during booking.
fallback: I can help with pet care services, appointment enquiries, pricing, and clinic support. What would you like to know?
